set.body:
Type: implementation or qualification task
Plan: docs/institutional-pilot-epics.md
Assessment: docs/institutional-readiness-plan.md
Work key: SITE01.3
Accountable role (person unassigned): Product owner with institutional operator and curator
Pilot scope: required

Scope: Turn institutional needs into explicit launch criteria and dependency changes.
Work kind: institutional
Acceptance gate: SITE01 (bd-01M4W40J6HFTNMMMEH40K1KSYM)

Acceptance criteria:
1. Record accepted load/memory/latency targets, recovery point/time objectives, revocation bound and support envelope; reconcile deviations from existing PRD targets explicitly.
2. Record native-BIDS versus DICOM/XNAT and visualization choices. When needed, add EP7 or EP8 as a program dependency and a dependency of Q03.3; otherwise record deferred scope without claiming implementation.
3. Publish the required-evidence matrix and distinguish permission to run a limited beta from a future primary-repository cutover.

Verification: Named owner/curator/operator acceptance of the scope matrix plus a checked mote dependency diff.
Expected evidence: docs/evidence/institutional-pilot/SITE01.3/receipt.json
Evidence must include: exact source/artifact and configuration identity; commands or human procedure and observed outcomes; fixtures/data scope and environment; acceptance-criterion results, negative cases and limitations; reviewer/acceptance evidence when the task requires institutional input.

External inputs (never assume supplied):
- Institutional acceptance of targets and pilot scope

Starting code/evidence:
- docs/institutional-readiness-plan.md#1-what-we-can-responsibly-stand-up
- docs/prd.md

Blocked by:
- SITE01.2: bd-01M4W5P46THC7WFA4FD0B1A68Z

Completion rule: satisfy every acceptance criterion with observed evidence. Failed or not-run requirements stay open. Preserve scientific identity/history and current authority; create blocking remediation work for discovered scope. Automated or simulated evidence cannot replace a required institutional or human result. No implementation is claimed by this plan.
